title: Machine Learning Engineer | Competitive Compensation | LLMs
description: Machine Learning Engineer – LLMs Want to build LLM-powered systems that have to work reliably in the real world? We’re looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to help build and deploy production-grade AI systems , with a particular focus on LLMs and modern generative AI. This isn’t a research-only role. You’ll work across models, data, evaluation and production systems - turning the latest advances in AI into reliable, high-impact products. What you’ll do Build and ship LLM-powered features and systems into production Design robust evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance Experiment with prompting, fine-tuning, retrieval and agentic approaches Build data and ML pipelines that support rapid experimentation at scale Optimise models and inference for latency, reliability and cost Work closely with software, product and domain experts to solve difficult real-world problems Help shape the company’s ML architecture, tooling and technical direction You’ll ideally bring: Excellent Python and software engineering skills Strong experience with PyTorch and modern ML tooling Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs A strong understanding of transformers, embeddings and modern NLP Experience with LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, RAG and/or agentic systems Experience taking ML models from experimentation through to production Strong judgement around model quality, data, performance and trade-offs What’s on offer Competitive salary + equity 7% pension Private healthcare Free daily meals Significant technical ownership from day one The opportunity to build cutting-edge AI that gets deployed in the real world You’ll need the right to work in the UK and be eligible for UK SC clearance . This is an office-first role , with flexibility when needed.
